c74object.name: mc.syncSuite.reverb~
c74object.digest: A reverb that lives in the speaker space: early reflections from the real geometry, a decorrelated diffuse tail on every speaker.
c74object.description: The speakers are placed where they are (speaker_coords, at speaker_distance from the listener) inside a shoebox room around the listener, and each speaker feed is a source in that room. EARLY REFLECTIONS: image sources (Allen & Berkley) up to er_order, each with its true path delay after the direct sound (the dry signal itself), 1/r level relative to the direct path and the walls' absorption per band, panned (VBAP) to the speakers in its direction: a reflection off the left wall of a sound from the front right arrives from the left, when it would. LATE FIELD: a feedback delay network of 16 to 64 lines (orthogonal mixing, delays around the room's mean free path), each line with a three-band decay that gives exactly rt60 low / mid / high, and a gentle delay modulation against ringing; every speaker reads it through its own orthogonal vector, so the tails are mutually uncorrelated and the field is diffuse around the listener. ONE ROOM: the wall absorption comes from the rt60 (Sabine), so early reflections and tail describe the same room, and the late level is calibrated to the diffuse field of that room at the speaker distance (reverberant / direct energy = 16 pi r^2 / A); er and late trim it. LFE channels pass dry. No latency. Display: room (the lattice of mirrored rooms with the image sources; click a speaker to see only its reflections), echogram (when each reflection reaches each speaker, colour = order, dashed = late onset), decay (rt60 per band), wet meters (early / late per speaker), room data (volume, mean free path, absorption, reverberant / direct, onset). CPU: about 1.2 % of a core for 8 speakers, 3.6 % for 32 (48 kHz, order 3).

method.name: signal
method.description: A multichannel signal, one channel per speaker (up to 128).

method.name: get
method.description: room <volume m3> <surface m2> <mean free path ms>, absorption <low mid high>, late_to_direct <dB>, onset <ms>, early <dB per channel>, late <dB per channel>.

attribute.name: speaker_coords
attribute.description: One azimuth per channel (channel i = speaker i), the same message syncSuite.nodes uses and outputs (get_speakers). Empty = an even ring of the non-LFE channels straddling the front (2 = L/R, 4 = quad, 8 = octagon).

attribute.name: speaker_elevations
attribute.description: Degrees, up, one per channel (missing = 0). All spatial computations are in 3D; the displays are top views.

attribute.name: lfe
attribute.description: Channels that are LFE: they have no position and are kept out of the spatial processing and the loudness. lfe with no values = none.

attribute.name: room
attribute.description: Width (x, left-right), depth (y, front-back) and height (z) in metres, 2 to 80. The listener is at the centre, at ear_height. Default: 18 14 7.

attribute.name: speaker_distance
attribute.description: Where the speakers are, around the listener (m). Sets the direct path every reflection is compared with, and the reverberant / direct balance (farther = more reverb). Default: 2.5.

attribute.name: ear_height
attribute.description: Listener's ear height above the floor (m): places the floor and ceiling reflections. Default: 1.2.

attribute.name: rt60
attribute.description: Reverberation time (s) in the low, mid and high bands (a single value = all three). Sets the late decay and, through Sabine's formula, the absorption of the walls. Default: 2.4 2. 1.2.

attribute.name: crossovers
attribute.description: Where low meets mid and mid meets high (Hz), for the decay and the wall absorption. Default: 250 4000.

attribute.name: er_order
attribute.description: Highest order of the image sources: 0 = no early reflections, 1 = the six walls, up to 4 (129 images per speaker). Default: 3.

attribute.name: predelay
attribute.description: Extra delay (ms) before everything reverberant, on top of the geometry's own. Default: 0.

attribute.name: er
attribute.description: Early reflections against their physical level (dB). Default: 0.

attribute.name: late
attribute.description: Late field against its physical level (dB). Default: 0.

attribute.name: wet
attribute.description: Reverb (early + late) level (dB). Default: 0.

attribute.name: dry
attribute.description: Dry signal level (dB); -120 or less = off (reverb only, e.g. on a send).

attribute.name: diffusion
attribute.description: Allpass diffusion of the signal entering the late field (0..1): smoother onset at higher values. Default: 0.7.

attribute.name: modulation
attribute.description: Slow delay modulation inside the network (0..1): prevents metallic ringing; 0 = static. Default: 0.25.

attribute.name: freeze
attribute.description: 1: the tail sustains indefinitely and nothing new enters it. Default: 0.

attribute.name: lines
attribute.description: Size of the delay network: auto (16, or more for more than 16 speakers), 16, 32, 64. Changing it restarts the tail. Values: 0 = auto, 1 = 16, 2 = 32, 3 = 64 (a number or the name). Default: 0.

attribute.name: view
attribute.description: Which panels are drawn: all, or one of them filling the box. Values: 0 = all, 1 = room, 2 = echogram, 3 = decay, 4 = meters (a number or the name). Default: 0.

attribute.name: bypass_ui
attribute.description: 1: nothing is drawn and the display timer stops; the audio and the message output are not affected (use it when the box is hidden or while performing). Default: 0.

attribute.name: output
attribute.description: 1: the measurements (see get) are output at every display refresh with new data. 0: only on get.

attribute.name: interval
attribute.description: Display refresh and output rate. The processing does not depend on it. Default: 33.

attribute.name: no_ui
attribute.digest: No UI: a plain object box
attribute.description: Type it with the object (mc.syncSuite.limiter~ @no_ui 1): the box looks and sizes like a standard object box, draws nothing, runs no display timer and skips the display-only metering. Max decides per class whether a box is a UI box, so the box stays resizable, but it behaves as a standard object: audio, messages and get work as usual. Default: 0.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: No UI: a plain object box

attribute.name: select
attribute.digest: Speaker whose reflections are shown (0 = all)
attribute.description: Speaker whose image sources and reflections are shown (0 = all). Also by clicking a speaker in the room panel.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Speaker whose reflections are shown (0 = all)

attribute.name: bgcolor
attribute.description: Box background (syncSuite style: near black).

attribute.name: panelcolor
attribute.description: Panel background.

attribute.name: textcolor
attribute.description: Labels and numbers.

attribute.name: gridcolor
attribute.description: Scales and guides.

attribute.name: color
attribute.description: Main signal colour (syncSuite hot pink).

attribute.name: alarmcolor
attribute.description: Overs, clips, gated / frozen states (acid yellow).

inlet.digest: Speaker feeds (channel i = speaker i) and messages

outlet.digest: Dry + reverb per speaker (same channels as the input)
Measurements: room, absorption, late_to_direct, onset, early, late
